Here is a list of things the `golemverse` team plans on working on.

If you feel like helping, feel free to open an issue / discussion / PR on one of the repository.

Last edit: (2026-07-10)

## Short term roadmap (3 to 6 months)

+ Stable, production ready version of `{brochure}`

+ Rework of the golemverse website:

  - Auto generate website content from yaml

  - Repair badge in package table

+ golemverse package triage:

  - Create a lifecycle policy (Core, experimental, Abandoned)

  - Bring the following package to the golemverse:

    - `{pw}`
    - `{bootstrict}`
    - `golem-agent-skills`

  - Tag these as "Core":

    - `{bootstrict}`
    - `{brochure}`
    - `{dockerfiler}`
    - `{fakir}`
    - `{gargoyle}`
    - `{golem}`
    - `{pw}`
    - `{shinipsum}`

  - Tag these as "Experimental":

    - `{bank}`
    - `{elvis}`
    - `{ghooks}`
    - `{shinidraw}`

  - Tag these as "Abandoned":

    - `{gemstones}`
    - `{minifyr}`
    - `{w3css}`

+ Dashboard template for `{brochure}`

+ Clean `{shinipsum}` repository (CRAN sync, rebuild README)

## Mid term (6 to 12 months)

+ Stable, CRAN version for `{bootstrict}`

+ Stable, CRAN version for `{pw}`

+ `{golemverse}` package à la `{tidyverse}` to simplify installation.

+ Integrate a storage mechanism in `{gargoyle}`. I'm thinking of a simple port of <https://github.com/ColinFay/odds>. <https://github.com/ColinFay/gargoyle/issues/12>

+ Write a blogpost about `{gargoyle}`
